selection: Curated illustrative results, not a representative benchmark sample.
geometry_policy: Reject poor candidates. No manual shape repair, part deletion, remeshing or decimation of selected outputs.
diagnostics_note: Proximity includes valid contact interfaces. Ray-parity containment is an approximate screening signal for open meshes, not a watertightness or exact intersection guarantee. Final decisions include visual inspection.
surface_threshold_units: one voxel = 1/512 of normalized object coordinates
surface_sampling: Initial collection: area-weighted face-centroid proximity. New candidates: up to 20,000 area-proportional centroid draws per part, seed 4096.
containment_sampling: 48,000 uniform bounding-box samples per part, seed 8912, Embree ray parity.

inspection: five verification renders (four azimuths + top view)
accepted.note: colors applied via sync_part_colors.py (paper linear palette, chroma 0.85); surface-proximity and ray-parity audits not re-run for this refresh
accepted.postprocess: release pipeline verbatim (decode-time fill_holes, relabel_parts.py eps 2.0, no simplification); dust components measured as on-surface skin patches and attached to the nearest part across volumes instead of being deleted
